title: Verification of Protein Changes by Parallel Reaction Monitoring (PRM)
author: Lihui Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.upvevn6
materials: 200ug protein was taken from each sample of each group separately, and 10fmol heavy isotope-labeled peptide DSPSAPVNVTVR (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.) was incorporated as internal standard.

Samples were added to the trap column and then gradient separated using a Thermo scientific EASY column at rate of 300nl/min. PRM mass spectrometric analysis was undertaken by Q-Exactive HF (Thermo Scientific Inc.).

steps.title: Reduce Proteins
steps.instruction: Add DTT to a final concentration of 10 mM and heat in a boiling water bath for 15 min, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add UA Buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 30 min, then mix in 200 μL UA buffer (8M Urea, 150mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Alkylate Proteins
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL IAA (50mM IAA in UA) and shake at 600 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash with NH4HCO3 Buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 20 min twice, then add 100 μL NH4HCO3 buffer (50mM).

steps.title: Digest Proteins with Trypsin
steps.instruction: Shake at 600 rpm for 1 min, then add 40 μL NH4HCO3 buffer containing 4 μg Trypsin.

steps.title: Final Wash and Peptide Recovery
steps.instruction: Add 40 μL NH4HCO3 buffer (50mM), centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 30 min, and collect the filtrate.

substeps.instruction: Desalt and lyophilize the digested peptides

steps.title: Perform HPLC Separation
steps.instruction: Perform chromatographic separation using Easy nLC HPLC with Buffer A (0.1% Formic acid aqueous solution) and Buffer B (84% acetonitrile with 0.1% formic acid aqueous solution).

steps.title: Acquire MS Full Scans
steps.instruction: Perform full scans for 60 min with a mass range of 300–1800 m/z at a resolution of 60,000 (@m/z 200).

steps.title: Collect PRM MS2 Scans
steps.instruction: Collect 20 PRM (MS2 scans) according to the inclusion list after each full MS scan using HCD activation with a normalized collision energy of 27.

steps.title: Analyze Data with Skyline
steps.instruction: Analyze the original files using Skyline software version 3.5.0.

substeps.instruction: Manually check and correct peak selection based on MS/MS spectra, retention time, transitions, and mass accuracy

steps.title: Perform Relative Quantitative Analysis
steps.instruction: Normalize quantitative information using the heavy isotope-labeled peptide to perform relative quantitative analysis on the target peptide and target protein.
